chapter: Early bands and the Fritz family in Mandeville
title: Lewis on playing with many bands, Punch Miller and Ray Allen's father
summary: Lewis says he played a few jobs with Punch and worked in Georgia Boyd's place, and played with nearly every New Orleans band off and on, including a brass band led by Allen's father.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I played a couple of jobs with punch during the time when they... when they had the band with Eddie Morris and, uh... I worked in Georgia Boyd's place and... Uh... No, that was in the early... early...early 20th. But, uh... See, as a steady man, I never worked at, but... in fact, I played with practically every band in the Orleans, off and on, some... and so on,
And Ray Allen for a while, too, that's right.
Ray Allen? I played Ray Allen's father.
Did he have a dance band, or...
No, I had a brass band, yeah. Only brass band. A brass band, yeah.
